content:
/* ============================================================================
   MFC Youth Area Management System - Global Stylesheet
   ============================================================================
   Purpose:
   - Provides all foundational CSS variables, typography (Inter), and colors.
   - Defines global layouts (Auth screens, Member Portal, Area Dashboard).
   - Contains styling for all components: cards, tables, forms, modals, alerts,
     and skeleton loaders used across the application.
   ============================================================================ */

declarations:
width: 8px;
  height: 8px;
background: transparent;
background-color: rgba(8, 120, 189, 0.65);
background: transparent;
display: none !important;
font: inherit;
color: inherit;

transition:
    transform var(--motion-fast) var(--ease-out),
    opacity var(--motion-fast) var(--ease-out),
    filter var(--motion-fast) var(--ease-out);

transform: translateY(0) scale(0.985);
  box-shadow: 0 5px 10px rgba(8, 120, 189, 0.1);
border: 1px solid transparent;
opacity: 1;

opacity: 0;
  transform: translate3d(0, 16px, 0);
animation: fadeInUp 420ms var(--ease-out) both;
box-shadow: inset 0 2px 8px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.18), 0 0 0 1px rgba(87, 170, 230, 0.72);
color: #9aa7b4;

color: #7cc4f9;
  text-decoration: none;
text-decoration: underline;
